testimonials.author: zayna parvez
testimonials.text: Really good experience—quick and efficient completion of my Saudi visa medical examination.

testimonials.author: Brian Bacon
testimonials.text: Exceptional support, depth and rigorous insights from Dr Mariyah Iqbal - professional guidance with a human touch. Caring, clear and decisive. Much appreciated.

testimonials.author: Anita Young
testimonials.text: Did the annual health check, staff was lovely and accommodating. Smooth process overall. Would recommend!

testimonials.author: Chris Dodd
testimonials.text: Extremely friendly staff. Everything was swift and easy. Highly recommend

testimonials.author: Whitney
testimonials.text: Dr Michelle was amazing! She took her time with me throughout the entire health assesment and really listened to me. I highly recommend this practice

testimonials.author: Nick Von Schirnding
testimonials.text: Dr Bachelani is an excellent medical practitioner and is very thorough with his checkups - and easy to engage with.

testimonials.author: Jesper
testimonials.text: I've had several appointments at London Harley Street Practice, and really appreciate the balance between professionalism, friendliness and reliability, at their very nice and confidence-inspiring clinic. It's been a good experience at every point. Can highly recommend. Update: Seeing Dr. Ayesha Aslam was the best thing I've done in a long, long time. She really helped me improve myself. Highly recommend.

testimonials.author: Stevie George
testimonials.text: highly recommended - wonderful service and great people
